entries.name: Old Wooden Board

item_resolution.note: MeowDB item 442 'Old Wooden Board' (the breakable's own drop list, api_breakable-drops_q_breakableId_0000001.html).

chance_source.interpretation: KuroDB reactor value "Chance value N" read as a 1-in-N chance (1 / N), as in the OdinMS-family reactor code; decision D3-7. KuroDB shows it as a value, not a percentage.

quantity.source: not published: KuroDB reactor rows ("Chance value N") carry no quantity

adaptation.reason: A resolved drop needs a quantity and KuroDB gives none for reactor (breakable) drops. One per roll is the reading that goes with decision D3-7 (KuroDB reactor values follow the OdinMS-family reactor code, whose reactor drops have no quantity). MeowDB publishes no quantity either.

quest_gate.basis: MeowDB item subtype "Quest Item" (items/442.json) and the membership source lists it as "Quest Item"; quest 1012 (Pio's Collecting Recycled Goods) asks for 3 in objectives.item_collection, so the entry rolls only while 1012 is in progress. KuroDB's "Quest 1008" flag (its own quest id) corroborates.
quest_gate.rule: C1 quest-gate rule (docs/runtime/ITERATION_THREE_CONTRACTS.md): a MisoStory derivation

notes: MeowDB subtype 'Quest Item', required by quest 1012: quest-gated under the C1 rule (D3-9). KuroDB's 'Quest 1008' is its own quest id, recorded as corroboration.

entries.name: Egg

item_resolution.note: MeowDB item 237 'Egg' (the breakable's own drop list).

notes: Membership is MeowDB's; the chance is unresolved, so Egg never drops from the box (D3-7). No quest needs it.

meowdb_reference.note: MeowDB's community-voted Classic drop list for this breakable (with votes), from the live page. For the Wooden Box this list IS the membership: Hidden Street has no breakables (D3-7).

probability.reactor_identity: KuroDB has no breakables section; reactor drops appear on item pages. Reactor 2001 is taken to be MeowDB's Wooden Box: it is the only reactor that drops both Old Wooden Board and Rusty Screw for Pio's recycling quest plus Apple (tools/kurodb/captures/reactor_2001_items.json reactor_identity_inference).

meowdb_reference.item_ids.note: MeowDB item ids for the breakable's list, matched by name within MeowDB's own cached breakable drop list

gaps: chance unresolved: "Egg" is on MeowDB's Wooden Box list but no read KuroDB page gives reactor 2001 a value for it, so it never drops (D3-7)
quantity per roll: KuroDB reactor rows give none; 1 per roll is a MisoStory adaptation (each entry's quantity.adaptation, verified: false)

KuroDB-only drops: KuroDB has no page listing every drop of reactor 2001; only the item pages of MeowDB's members were read, so no KuroDB-only row is known (excluded_kuro_only is empty for that reason)
mesos: none. MeowDB has no meso reports for breakables and KuroDB lists no meso drop for reactors; meso is null (the box never drops mesos)
notes: Membership: MeowDB's live Wooden Box page (https://meowdb.com/msclassic/breakables/0000001, read 2026-10-05T07:49:44.592Z); Hidden Street has no breakables (D3-7).

Chance: KuroDB reactor 2001 rows on the members' item pages (tools/kurodb/captures/reactor_2001_items.json). KuroDB has no breakables section; reactor drops appear on item pages. Reactor 2001 is taken to be MeowDB's Wooden Box: it is the only reactor that drops both Old Wooden Board and Rusty Screw for Pio's recycling quest plus Apple (tools/kurodb/captures/reactor_2001_items.json reactor_identity_inference).
"Chance value N" is read as 1 / N, an interpretation (decision D3-7).
Runtime (contract C1): an entry rolls only when chance_state is resolved, item_id is not null and quest_gate is null or its quest is in progress.
